title: Inventory and Order Processing System
objective: Build reliable inventory management around concurrent purchases.
scenario: Build reliable inventory management around concurrent purchases. Use synthetic data and work only in a dedicated, disposable MySQL schema.

milestones.title: Model and define
acceptance_criteria: Document entities, grain, keys, types and constraints.
Include a diagram or schema notes.

milestones.title: Populate and query
acceptance_criteria: Deliver representative queries and expected result checks.

milestones.title: Verify and harden
acceptance_criteria: Test constraints, NULLs, duplicates and failure paths.
Record security, version, performance or recovery considerations appropriate to the project.

starter_material.notes: Starter is a learning scaffold, not a reviewed production migration. Add seed data, tests, teardown and documentation.

stretch_features: Add a README with assumptions and commands.
Add negative/failure tests and explain expected outcomes.
Record execution plans or operational verification where relevant.
acceptance_criteria: All schema/query files are version-controlled and runnable in an isolated lab.
Synthetic seed data is deterministic and has no real personal data.
Expected outcomes, edge cases and verification results are documented.
Security and version-dependent behaviors are explicitly labeled.
test_plan: Create the schema in a fresh disposable database.
Run valid and invalid sample cases and verify constraints.
Repeat tests after rebuilding from source scripts.
For advanced operational projects, rehearse rollback/restore/failure recovery and record evidence.

rubric.criterion: Schema/design correctness and normalized row grain

status_note: Draft project. Reference solution is protected and should be used by reviewers rather than returned in public APIs.
review_method: Human review with local static validation; execute SQL only in a disposable MySQL lab before publication.
